messages:
support-ops: FYI — after the weekend metrics-router cutover were seeing p95/p99 lines vanish from the latency SLO panels in multiple regions (eu-west-1, us-west-2). Tenant dashboards sometimes show tails but org-level SLO view is blank/flat. Started ~03:10 UTC after canary. Any ideas?

alex: Can you post the dashboard link and a quick screenshot? Is this limited to the SLO panels or are other percentile charts affected?

support-ops: Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/org/observability/dash/latency-slos?view=region (screenshot attached). Appears quantile series are dropped entirely for org aggregation. p50/avg show up. Happened right after the canary.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: metrics-router v2.4.0 canary promoted at 2024-08-11T03:12Z by @jordan :white_check_mark:

jordan: I pushed a metrics transform at 03:12 that strips some low-cardinality tags to reduce ingest. Looking at the config diff now — we may have accidentally included the percentile tag in the drop list. Investigating.

maria: Can you run an ad-hoc query against the metrics API and paste the raw series? Example curl: 
```
curl -s -XPOST https://metrics-api.redwood.ai/query -d '{"query":"latency_ms:p99{service:inference,region:eu-west-1} | rollup(60)"}'
```

support-ops: Ran that — returned an empty series list for p99 across affected orgs. p50/p95? p50 present, p95 empty as well.

alex: If percentile-tag series are getting dropped we should revert the transform flag in canary. That will be the fastest mitigation.

jordan: I can flip the transform flag in canary now. Captured the bad config: transform.rules.drop_tags included "percentile_label" by mistake in commit 9f8a2c.

maria: Repro steps for a support ticket: 1) Open Org latency SLO dashboard 2) Set time window to 1h 3) Observe p95/p99 lines missing 4) Run the curl query above and confirm empty p95/p99 series 5) Note that tenant-level dashboards still show tails. Attach logs and screenshot.

jordan: Flipped flag at 03:28 UTC in canary. Can everyone check the console? If green I'll promote to stable.

support-ops: Still seeing blank in org-level eu-west-1 for me. Tenant-level looks better. @alex any differences on your end?

alex: Tenant-level p95/p99 returned for single-tenant view. Org aggregation still missing tails. My guess: the aggregation step filters out series that lost the percentile tag rather than preserving it.

jordan: Confirmed — aggregation layer filters out series when percentile tag is absent after transform. Im opening a PR to keep percentile tags or skip them from drop list and adding regression tests. Incident created: INC-789. Notifying oncall.

support-ops: Noted. Workaround: drill into tenant-level or set a tenant scope filter; that surfaces p95/p99 for affected customers. Communicated workaround to CS and impacted customers. :white_check_mark:

maria: I'll file the support ticket with repro, query output, screenshots, and link to INC-789 and loop in CS. Thanks everyone — will update when the PR is merged.
